Class IngestionConfiguration

java.lang.Object
io.micronaut.langchain4j.rag.IngestionConfiguration
@EachProperty("langchain4j.rag.ingestion") public final class IngestionConfiguration extends Object
Configures the ingestion of documents into an embedding store: the documents are loaded from the sources, split into segments, embedded with the embedding model and stored. An EmbeddingStoreIngestor bean named after the configuration is created to ingest other documents.
Since:
2.4.0
